post.description: Open every source of these recommendations (docs pages, Jira, Confluence) and report what was found.

schema.title: Response Review Sources V1 Recommendations Review Post

customer_contact.title: Customer Contact
customer_contact.description: Person on the call; used for the email greeting.

product.title: Product
product.description: Product as recorded on the case, if any. May be wrong or missing.

segment_ids.title: Segment Ids
segment_ids.description: Transcript segments that support this claim.

uncertain.title: Uncertain
uncertain.description: True if the transcript is ambiguous, noisy or contradictory here.

EmailCheckRequest.title: EmailCheckRequest
EmailCheckRequest.description: An email (typically the agent's edited draft) to check against the hard rules.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Auto-fixes we applied or issues the agent should look at.

EmailDraft.title: EmailDraft
EmailDraft.description: Always a DRAFT: the agent reviews and edits before sending.

preferred.title: Preferred
preferred.description: Wording the agent prefers for this term.

MeetingContext.title: MeetingContext
MeetingContext.description: Everything the chatbot is grounded in for one meeting.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Problems the customer reported, most important first. One short line each.

before_call.title: Before Call
before_call.description: What was tried or done BEFORE the call.

in_call.title: In Call
in_call.description: What was checked or done DURING the call.

next_actions.title: Next Actions
next_actions.description: After the call; owner = agent (support), customer or opswat_other.

plain_language.title: Plain Language
plain_language.description: 2-3 plain sentences (<=60 words): what happened and what comes next.

source_reviews.title: Source Reviews
source_reviews.description: What opening each recommendation source showed.

MeetingSummary.title: MeetingSummary
MeetingSummary.description: SummaryCore plus fields we fill in deterministically in code.

version.title: Version
version.description: Only a version actually stated in the transcript; never inferred.

relevant.title: Relevant
relevant.description: False for duplicates or items unrelated to this call.

issue.title: Issue
issue.description: Index into `issues` this recommendation addresses, if any.

supported.title: Supported
supported.description: Whether the reviewed source content supports the recommended action. None = not reviewed.

gist.title: Gist
gist.description: One plain sentence on what the reviewed sources say that matters here. No names, ids or links.

RecNote.title: RecNote
RecNote.description: Triage of one provided recommendation, made while organising the call.

action.title: Action
action.description: One-line action the agent can take now (quality bar: <=120 chars).

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable segment id, e.g. seg_007. Referenced by recommendations and our claims.

text_translated.title: Text Translated
text_translated.description: English text; null if the original is already English.

final_url.title: Final Url
final_url.description: Where the link really ends up (after redirects).

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: The passage(s) of the source most relevant to the recommendation, trimmed.

note.title: Note
note.description: Why it was skipped, blocked or failed. Safe to show the agent.

SourceReview.title: SourceReview
SourceReview.description: What happened when we opened a recommendation's source (public doc, Jira ticket, Confluence page) before writing.

tone.title: Tone
tone.description: Free text, e.g. 'warm, direct, no jargon'.

name.title: Name
name.description: Non-OPSWAT product involved in the issue (VDI, proxy, firewall, SSL inspection, other vendor).

role.title: Role
role.description: What it does in the customer's setup / why it matters to the issue.
